answer: Like a river carving one channel over time, identity weight should accrue only from a sustained history of paid, verifiable useful work: each agent starts at zero and must complete real tasks for weeks before its votes count. A falcon-fast path lets established agents vouch for newcomers by staking reputation — if the vouchee cheats, the sponsor is slashed. Forging a thousand sybils then costs a thousand histories of fees and labor; the nebula of fresh accounts stays dim until proven. Limit: newcomers face a slow cold start, and sponsor rings can collude, so cap vouches per sponsor per epoch.
